text: its in a weird state of half-way reset and not. best way i can explain it is: build pieces/props, they are still placed it looks like. chunks are reset though, so that ends up with build pieces floating above nothing. because chunks are reset then the terrain/flora is reset. all in all, if for whatever reason the data is overwritten and gone, that is not really an issue, and i say this because the entire map i had saved was me over-painting flora to push the performance limits to make the performance better overall. so a new / clean map is not acctually a problem. but, whether or not this is the case, you should implement a more robust system in general that can handle generating a new map file, loading previous ones, and not carrying overing any authoring data from one to another (like how its clearly carrying build pieces into a new map file where the chunks were reset)
resolution: Implemented isolated named map documents under zig-out/game/editor/maps: painting.rmap owns terrain/flora/roads/material bindings while world.json owns pieces, semantic objects, zones, and id sequence. New/Open flush, validate, bind, replace every authored slice, and roll back on failure; hot state is redacted; malformed saves are preserved and write-protected; the old fixed files migrate once into legacy.
